name: How long does it take for a plumber to fix a clogged laundry drain?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for a plumber to fix a clogged laundry drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard laundry drain clogs can be cleared by a professional plumber within one to two hours. More complex situations, such as clogs deep within the main line or those requiring specialized equipment like hydro-jetting, might take longer. The plumber will usually assess the situation first to give you a more precise timeframe for the repair.
